source_selection: User-nominated primary lead; file and context inspection only, without fitting, scoring, outcome-based filtering or scientific target replacement.

author_repository.primary_authorship_evidence: DESCRIPTION identifies Sean Hackett as author/creator; README explicitly states this repository contains the scripts and data reproducing Hackett 2016.

license.status: No reusable-data/software license verified; public retrieval does not establish a redistribution license. No full raw source was persisted or handed to a learner.

author_repository.retrieval: gh api with a 28-second subprocess timeout per request; exact commit, Git blob digest, SHA256 and byte count verified before schema parsing; no package installation and no author analysis code executed.

schema.row_width_verification: Every data row has exactly 26 fields.
schema.source_cell_locator: Commit + file SHA256 + one-based TSV line + exact column header + Gene value. Header occupies line 1. No gene/value rows were exported.

measurement_semantics.class: Processed relative protein abundance, not absolute active enzyme concentration
measurement_semantics.instrument_lineage: LC-MS peptide isotopologue deconvolution against 15N-labeled reference; technical-replicate aggregation; inverse-variance peptide aggregation to protein; missing proteins can be KNN-imputed.
measurement_semantics.reference: Equal total protein mass mixed with a pooled 15N-labeled reference from two phosphate-limited cultures at nominal dilution 0.05 per hour.
measurement_semantics.TSV_exact_transform: Not explicitly encoded in the TSV header. Do not assume the TSV is either log2 or exponentiated abundance without an exact export-lineage record.
measurement_semantics.imputation_caveat: The paper reports KNN imputation but this TSV has no observed/imputed mask. It cannot silently be treated as an all-measured table or used with cross-fold KNN imputation.

files.reason: Mixed conditions; no approved split or direct reaction-rate label; transform/imputation lineage unresolved.

files.format: gzip-compressed RDX2 XDR R serialization version 2
files.parser_policy: Passive typed-object parser; numeric vector contents withheld; only authoritative dimension attributes, schema names/classes and predeclared specimen/batch strings exposed. Unsupported structure or trailing bytes refuses parsing.

mediaSummary.interpretation: Aggregated boundary concentration changes/uncertainties/bounds, not raw NMR spectra and not yet the rate after multiplication by dilution rate.
mediaSummary.molecular_units: No unit attribute verified in the serialized schema. Require the primary calibration/export lineage to resolve molarity scale before any mmol/gDW/h adapter.

comp_by_cond.lineage_caveat: Biomass composition, molecular conversions and stoichiometric/energetic biomass demands are mixed in this object. Names such as anabolicFlux and compartment annotations do not certify a measured reaction flux or a compartment-specific metabolite measurement.

schema.source_cell_locator: Commit + file SHA256 + R object path + one-based row/column + exact condition/species field. Matrix row/column names and derivation inputs must be verified for any later projection.

files.reason: Mixed conditions, experimental summaries and model-related biomass inputs. No full RData handoff; no direct intracellular rate label.

condition_identity_inventory.join_warning: Preserve case and the follow-up identifier; a nominal condition match is not proof of the same biological sample. In particular, do not replace u0.30_10.28 with a protein/Boer sample merely by stripping its suffix.
condition_identity_inventory.batch_dependency_warning: The source records one shared NMR_date for 24 rows and a follow-up date for row 25. Apply the verifier's day/batch dependency rule before counting independent groups. Shared protein-reference cultures and metabolomics reference samples must also enter the ancestry graph.

facts.fact: Loads the protein TSV and uses Gene as the row identifier.
Loads medium formulation and the boundary RData; the latter supplies actual culture dilution metadata.
Selects mediaSummary by ChemostatCond; adds missing nutrient bounds; multiplies concentration change, sd and bounds by actualDR to construct exchange-rate inputs.
Removes measured phosphate change/uncertainty from the optimization input. A model-ready input is not identical to the measured boundary table.
Adds an approximated oxygen uptake based on other boundary variables and respiratory-quotient assumptions. This oxygen constraint is not an independently measured exchange flux.
Converts cultureMolarity to biomass demands and adds stoichiometric energetic costs. These are explicitly derived biomass/model inputs, not measured enzyme initial rates.

eligibility_under_current_protocol.decision_basis: Metadata and primary methods only, not response values or model performance.
eligibility_under_current_protocol.fatal_label_mismatch: The stated pyruvate-kinase intracellular flux is an optimized YEASTNET-7/FVA quantity. It is prohibited by claim_domain.json's only-teacher/FBA-label criterion and by the custodian instruction.
additional_unresolved_gates: Metabolomics originates in prior Boer cultures, not the proteomics/fluxomics biological culture

eligibility_under_current_protocol.new_target_policy: Boundary exchange or a purified/extract activity target requires a different explicit protocol and metadata-only eligibility assessment before any values are exported. No silent substitution.
